title: Quick pick item
description: A row in the quick input list: optional file icon, label with match highlight, description, keybinding, group separator label and row actions.

attributes.name: highlight
attributes.description: Substring of the label to highlight (the filter match)

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Secondary text after the label (present-but-empty for file rows)

attributes.name: separator
attributes.description: Group label shown at the right of the first row of a group, e.g. 'recently opened'

attributes.name: file
attributes.description: Show a file icon (value = file name; empty = use label)

examples.title: Command rows
examples.html: <vsc-quick-pick-item label="Chat Agent Sessions: Toggle Agent Sessions Sidebar" highlight="Toggle" focused><vsc-action slot="actions" icon="gear" label="Configure Keybinding"></vsc-action></vsc-quick-pick-item><vsc-quick-pick-item label="Chat: Toggle Thinking Content in Accessible View" highlight="Toggle" keys="Alt+T"><vsc-action slot="actions" icon="gear" label="Configure Keybinding"></vsc-action></vsc-quick-pick-item>
